svg.title: The Ranger's Book 1: one day, three rows closed up
svg.desc: The ranger's logbook open on the booth counter, ruled in columns in Marisol's careful blue-black hand. The check-in rows have closed up where three lost sites were and the permit numbers skip; on the right her day's totals stand beside Tam's pencil sums, which come up short, and three blank ghost rows wait to be filled.
svg.text: Marisol: “These don’t add up. They always add up.”
